title.en: MC marker allocation by cell weight

summary: Allocate Monte Carlo marker counts over a 3-D cell volume: every active cell (positive weight) receives the minimum per-cell count, and the remainder is distributed by inverse-CDF sampling over the Fortran-order flattened weight volume with caller-owned uniform draws.

identity.relation: counts[cell] = minimum_per_active_cell for every cell with weight > 0; the remaining requested_markers - base markers are distributed by searchsorted(cdf(draws * total)) over the F-order flattened weight volume.
identity.direction: 3-D approximate cell weight + requested marker count + caller-owned CDF uniform draws + minimum per active cell -> per-cell marker counts (int64)
identity.definition: The saved FIDASIM get_nlaunch mapping (framework node N7 fast_ion_fida_response). The randomness stays caller-owned (deterministic, replayable mapping; no RNG is bound). The total allocated count must equal requested_markers.
identity.model: the saved formal implementation, ported verbatim with a registered marker-count conservation gate
identity.geometry: one 3-D weight volume; an int64 count volume of the same shape
identity.boundary: finite nonnegative weights; nonnegative integer requested_markers and minimum_per_active_cell; remainder draws finite in [0, 1); the total allocated count must equal requested_markers (registered hardening)
assumptions: The caller owns the random stream and supplies the CDF uniform variates.
No external physics reference is bound beyond the source closed form.

inputs.name: cdf_uniform_draws
inputs.description: Caller-owned uniform CDF variates for the remainder.
inputs.constraints: Finite; every entry in [0, 1); length equals the remainder after the minimum allocation.

outputs.name: marker_counts
outputs.constraints: Nonnegative; total exactly equals requested_markers (registered conservation gate); zero in every inactive cell.

preconditions: The caller owns the random stream and supplies the CDF uniform variates.
supported: Deterministic MC marker allocation over a beam-cell weight volume.
excluded: Weight-volume construction, the CDF/RNG stream itself, and MC trajectory following.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when weights are non-finite, negative or not 3-D, when requested_markers or minimum_per_active_cell is not exactly a nonnegative integer, when remainder draws are non-finite or outside [0, 1), or when the total weight is zero with a positive remainder.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if the allocated total does not equal requested_markers (registered conservation gate).

example.description: Allocate six markers over a single active cell: five from the minimum and one from the CDF remainder draw.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.fusion import allocate_mc_markers_by_weight
weight = np.ones((1, 1, 1))
counts = allocate_mc_markers_by_weight(
    approximate_cell_weight=weight, requested_markers=6,
    cdf_uniform_draws=np.array([0.5]), minimum_per_active_cell=5)
assert counts[0, 0, 0] == 6
assert int(counts.sum()) == 6
try:
    allocate_mc_markers_by_weight(
        approximate_cell_weight=weight, requested_markers=6,
        cdf_uniform_draws=np.array([1.0]), minimum_per_active_cell=5)
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('a draw at 1.0 must be rejected')
example.expected: Five minimum markers plus one CDF-distributed marker gives 6; a draw at the exclusive upper bound raises ValueError.

scope: Source allocation against an independent F-order CDF recomputation.
